name: Setting an image as primary updates the primary badge

preconditions.note: Requires a variant with at least 2 images

steps.description: Click the first variant's View Details button
steps.snapshotHint: View Details button in first variant row

steps.description: Count images on variant detail — need at least 2 for this test
Check if primary badge indicators exist
Click the set-as-primary button on a non-primary image
steps.snapshotHint: Look for a star icon, primary toggle, or similar button on one of the variant images

businessContext: Primary image is what shows on the catalog card — wrong primary means wrong first impression
